name: Blood of the Deep
body:
Though you are a vampire, somewhere in your history there is a powerful connection to the sea. Running water is no threat to you.

Prerequisites: Vampire.

Benefits: You are not harmed by running water as most vampires are and you gain a swim speed equal to your normal movement rate.

Way of the Wicked Book Five — The Devil My Only Master. Copyright 2012, Fire Mountain Games LLC; Author: Gary McBride.
